status: Retrospective extension, specified before this run; not preregistered or untouched external validation
purpose: Test incremental value of chart selection against simple task-matched defaults without forcing winner diversity
cases: All 127 original primary comparisons; resource is the resampling and holdout unit
candidates: Nine fixed v2 settings plus a 19-marker quantile control; quantile controls are separate configurations, not equal family tuning budgets
loss: Mean absolute target recovery error divided by pooled within-group SD; tasks reported separately, no weighted overall task score
selection: Train at 256 for each observer separately. Reference per-case selection and resource-disjoint per-task default frozen and evaluated at 384 with same observer. Oracle at 384 is descriptive bound only.
default_selection: Leave one resource out; select a valid fixed configuration minimizing resource-balanced mean loss separately for each task and observer; no heldout loss enters selection
ties: All scientific minima retained within 1e-12 absolute loss; deterministic configuration order only for deploying one setting
failures: Any failed placement invalidates a configuration; report counts rather than assigning favorable scores
uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of nine resource-level differences; descriptive intervals, not independent feature inference
example_rule: WDBC__00 used for all task comparisons, first primary case by canonical sorted key within WDBC; paired identifiability witness is explicitly synthetic
paired_task: Median within-person change is ineligible for marginal-only renderers; provide constructive witness and rejection rather than score
limitations: No human observations, no new external population, no multimodality target, finite summary controls do not retain all distributional information
